_about: Adult life events, age 20+ (age gives [min,max]). Each has a category tag first. 'redemptive' events are favored for heroes, 'dark' for villains. Original content written for DCUGen.

events.text: Was promoted ahead of more senior colleagues and made enemies doing it.

person.who: {npc}, a coworker passed over when {name} got the promotion
person.status: Still at the company, smiling in meetings and keeping notes.

events.text: Was laid off when {company} 'restructured' and spent a hard year looking for work.
Blew the whistle on safety violations at {company} and lost the job but won the lawsuit.

person.who: {npc}, the {company} executive whose career ended because of {name}'s whistleblowing
person.status: Now consulting for people who don't ask questions.

complication.text: A disgraced executive blames {name} for everything.

events.text: Started a small business that {thrived|barely survived|collapsed after two years}.
Was hired by a rival firm to dig into {company}'s secrets.
Took a night-shift job at {lab} and noticed that the 'cleaning crew' wore sidearms.
events.hook: {lab} is hiring again, and asking specifically for {name}.

events.text: Worked under a brilliant, impossible boss who taught more in a year than school did in four.

person.who: {npc}, a demanding former boss and the best teacher {name} ever had
person.status: Recently retired; calls when something in the news smells wrong.

events.text: Went freelance and learned to live on irregular paychecks and caffeine.
Won an industry award that still sits in a box somewhere.

complication.text: Is recognized in professional circles, which makes discretion harder.

events.text: Took the blame for a boss's mistake and was quietly pushed out.
events.regret: Taking the fall for someone who never said thank you.

events.text: Fell in love with {npc} and moved across the country to be together.

person.who: {npc}, the partner {name} crossed a country for
person.status: Still together, though the secrets are starting to show.

events.text: Got married young; it lasted {two|three|four} years.

person.who: {npc}, {name}'s former spouse
person.status: Remarried; cordial at weddings and funerals.

events.text: Was left at the altar by {npc}, who sent a text from the airport.

person.who: {npc}, who left {name} at the altar
person.status: Back in town and wants to talk.

events.text: Had a whirlwind affair with someone who turned out to be a costumed vigilante.

person.who: {npc}, a former lover who was secretly the vigilante known as {hero}
person.status: Still active under the mask; still calls on bad nights.

events.text: Dated a charming stranger who turned out to be working for a villain.

person.who: {npc}, a former lover who was a plant for {villain}
person.status: Disappeared after the truth came out.

events.text: Had a child with {npc}; co-parenting has been {easy|rough|a slow-motion war}.

person.who: {npc}, the other parent of {name}'s child
person.status: Co-parenting, with mixed results.

events.text: Fell for a coworker, {npc}, and has never said a word about it.

person.who: {npc}, a coworker {name} has quietly loved for years
person.status: Has no idea. Probably.

events.text: Went through a messy, public divorce that drained savings and friendships alike.

person.who: {npc}, {name}'s bitter ex-spouse
person.status: Still fighting over the house, the dog and the record collection.

events.text: Reconnected with a high-school sweetheart at a reunion.

person.who: {npc}, a high-school sweetheart found again
person.status: Together, and very worried about {name}'s late nights.

events.text: Was engaged to {npc}, who died before the wedding.
events.regret: Never getting to say goodbye to {npc}.

events.text: Got mixed up with a crew pulling {warehouse jobs|insurance scams|armored-car heists} and walked away with a cut and a conscience.
Was arrested on a charge {they_were} innocent of and spent {four|eight|eighteen} months awaiting trial.
events.motive: Distrusts a justice system that once got it badly wrong.

events.text: Was mugged at gunpoint, and something hardened afterward.
events.fear: Being unarmed in a dark street

events.text: Testified against {npc}, a crime boss, and lived under police protection for a year.

person.who: {npc}, a crime boss who went to prison on {name}'s testimony
person.status: Running things from a cell and remembers every name.

complication.text: A jailed crime boss has a standing bounty on the witness who put them away.

events.text: Laundered money for a cousin's business without asking questions, then asked them.
events.secret: Laundered money for organized crime and still has the ledgers.

events.text: Was a getaway driver for one job, just one, and never told anyone.
events.secret: Drove the getaway car on an unsolved robbery.

events.text: Was robbed of everything in a home invasion and moved twice afterward.
Went undercover as a volunteer to expose a fraudulent charity.
Ran an online scam that made good money until a victim's suicide made the news.
events.secret: Ran a scam that ended in someone's death.
events.regret: The scam victim whose name {name} still looks up.

events.text: Stole a car to get a dying friend to the hospital and was never charged.
Lost {their} home in a {fire|flood|gas explosion|building collapse}.
Was the only survivor of a {bus crash|train derailment|factory explosion|boat capsizing}.

complication.text: Survivor's guilt: needs to understand why only {name} walked away.

events.text: Lost a close friend in a costumed battle downtown, crushed by debris from a fight that lasted ninety seconds.
events.motive: Believes the people who fight in the streets owe the bystanders more.

events.text: Watched {their} {parent} slowly forget everyone, including {name}.
Suffered a miscarriage or a stillbirth in the family, and grief cracked the household.
Was diagnosed with a serious illness and fought it into remission.
Lost a beloved pet in a way that still hurts to think about.
Was declared legally dead by mistake and spent a year proving otherwise.
Won a {modest|surprisingly large} lottery prize.
Inherited a {house|bar|boat|warehouse|bookstore} from a relative {they_were} barely aware of.
events.hook: The inherited property has a locked room nobody can account for.

events.text: Found a bag of cash in an abandoned car and has never decided what to do with it.
events.secret: Has a bag of someone else's money hidden in a storage unit.
events.hook: The owner of the bag of cash is still looking for it.

events.text: Received a large anonymous gift with a note that said simply, 'For what you will do.'
Got a lucky break on a {patent|startup|real-estate flip} that set up the next decade.
Backpacked across {three continents|South America|Southeast Asia|Africa} for a year on almost no money.
Lived abroad for {two|three|five} years teaching English.
Was stranded in a country during a coup and smuggled out in a truck of oranges.
Spent a season working at a research station in Antarctica.
Followed a {band|circus|rodeo circuit} around the country for a year.
Enlisted in the military.
Was called up from the reserves for a deployment {they_were} not ready for.
Joined a private military contractor for the money.
Had a religious awakening after a near-death moment.
Lost faith entirely after a tragedy that no prayer could explain.
Joined a meditation retreat that turned out to be a recruiting front for a cult.

person.who: {npc}, the soft-spoken leader of a cult {name} escaped
person.status: Still preaching; still sends messages on {name}'s birthday.

events.text: Was badly hurt in a {car crash|workplace accident|fall from scaffolding} and went through a long rehabilitation.
Took a bullet meant for someone else and has the scar as a reminder.
Was hospitalized after a beating by {gang}, and the police never followed up.

complication.text: Hates {gang} with a cold, patient hatred.

events.text: Was caught in a lab accident at {lab}; the official report calls it a minor spill.
events.hook: Others exposed in the {lab} accident are dying, or changing.

events.text: Was the subject of a viral video that made {them} briefly famous for all the wrong reasons.

complication.text: Strangers still recognize {name} from an embarrassing viral video.

events.text: Was accused of {plagiarism|embezzlement|misconduct} and cleared, though the headlines lasted longer than the verdict.

complication.text: An old accusation still follows {name}, cleared or not.

events.text: Leaked a document that brought down a corrupt official.

person.who: {npc}, the official whose career {name}'s leak destroyed
person.status: Out of office and very, very patient.

events.text: Had an affair that ended a marriage and a friendship in the same week.
events.regret: The affair, and the people it hurt.

events.text: Was taken under the wing of a retired detective who taught how to really read a crime scene.

person.who: {npc}, a retired detective who taught {name} to see what others miss
person.status: Retired, bored and always willing to look at a case file.

events.text: Apprenticed with an eccentric inventor who kept a workshop full of patents nobody would fund.

person.who: {npc}, an eccentric inventor with a workshop of unfunded wonders
person.status: Missing since a break-in at the workshop.

events.text: Trained under a reclusive martial-arts master who accepted one student a decade.

person.who: {npc}, a reclusive martial-arts master
person.status: Has gone silent; the dojo is shuttered.

events.text: Was mentored by a veteran journalist who said the truth is always one more phone call away.

person.who: {npc}, a veteran journalist at {paper}
person.status: Still filing stories, still making enemies.

events.text: Was taught the art of the con by a grifter who called it 'applied psychology.'

person.who: {npc}, a silver-tongued grifter who taught {name} the con
person.status: Doing a stretch in {prison} and expects a visit.

events.text: Became the legal guardian of {sibling}'s kids after a family crisis.

complication.text: Is raising a sibling's children and can't afford to get hurt.

events.text: Reconnected with {their} estranged {parent} just before the end.
Had a falling-out with {sibling} over money that neither will apologize for.
Took in an elderly relative with nowhere else to go.

complication.text: Cares for an elderly relative who can't be left alone for long.

events.text: Discovered a sibling {they_were} never told about.

person.who: {npc}, a half-sibling discovered late in life
person.status: Getting to know each other; it's awkward and kind of wonderful.

events.text: Was blackmailed over an old mistake and paid for {two|three} years.

person.who: {npc}, a blackmailer who knows about {name}'s past
person.status: Quiet for now. That never lasts.

events.text: Volunteered for years at a shelter and ended up running it.
Ran for city council on a reform platform and lost by eleven votes.
Became a regular at {bar}, where the bartender knows everyone's secrets.

person.who: {npc}, the bartender at {bar} who hears everything
person.status: Pours the first drink free and the information cheap.

events.text: Organized the neighborhood to fight a developer's eviction plan, and won.

person.who: {npc}, the developer whose project the neighborhood blocked
person.status: Bought the building next door instead.

events.text: Started coaching a youth {boxing|basketball|robotics} program.
events.dependent: the kids in the youth program

events.text: Struggled with {drinking|painkillers|gambling} for years before getting clean.

complication.text: In recovery; one bad week away from a relapse.

events.text: Went through a long depression that friends only recognized in hindsight.
Ran a marathon after being told {they'd} never walk normally again.
Was sued into near-bankruptcy by a former business partner.

person.who: {npc}, a former business partner turned courtroom nemesis
person.status: Still filing motions.

events.text: Was held hostage during a bank robbery and talked the robbers into letting the children go.
Saved a stranger's life and was named in the paper as a 'good Samaritan.'

person.who: {npc}, a stranger whose life {name} saved
person.status: Insists on repaying the debt and won't take no for an answer.

events.text: Was framed for a crime and cleared only after a costumed detective found the real culprit.

person.who: {hero}, the masked detective who cleared {name}'s name
person.status: Drops by unannounced to ask for favors.

events.text: Got a job working for a costumed hero's civilian front company without knowing it.
Took a job as a 'consultant' for {villainGroup} and learned too much to quit.

person.who: {npc}, a recruiter for {villainGroup}
person.status: Expects {name} to come back to work.

complication.text: Once worked for {villainGroup}, and they don't accept resignations.

events.text: Turned state's evidence against former associates.

complication.text: Former associates want the informant who sold them out.

events.text: Broke with a criminal past after a {child|priest|cop|stranger} showed unexpected mercy.
Crossed a line during a job and decided it was easier to keep walking.
Was betrayed by a partner and left for dead; survival turned into ambition.

person.who: {npc}, the partner who left {name} for dead
person.status: Prospering, and unaware {name} survived.

events.motive: Settling accounts with the partner who left {them} for dead.

events.text: Was humiliated by a costumed hero on live television and has replayed it ever since.

person.who: {hero}, the hero who humiliated {name} on live television
person.status: Has probably forgotten the whole thing, which is worse.

complication.text: Burning hatred for the hero who humiliated {them} in public.

events.text: Lost everything to a corporation that faced no consequences, and decided rules were for the weak.
Moved to {city} with one suitcase and no plan.
Spent a year caring for {their} dying {parent}.
Went back to school at night and earned a degree while working full time.
Joined a search-and-rescue team after a disaster in {hometown}.
Lost a fortune in a crypto scheme and a friendship with the friend who pitched it.
Was a juror on a high-profile metahuman trial and received threats afterward.
events.hook: The defendant from the metahuman trial is up for parole.

events.text: Became a parent through adoption after years of trying.
Was mistaken for a costumed hero's civilian identity and hounded by reporters for a month.
Fostered a string of kids from the system and is still in touch with most of them.
Retired, tried to enjoy it, and lasted six months before going back to work.
Buried more friends than {they'd} like to count.
Became a grandparent and was startled to find {themself} sentimental about it.
